title: 检索无益：生物医学RAG的大规模研究
summary: 该研究在多种模型、数据集和检索方法上发现，检索增强生成（RAG）在生物医学问答中仅带来微小且不稳定的改进（1-2个百分点），主要瓶颈在于模型有效利用检索证据的能力，而非检索质量本身。
summary_en: This large-scale study finds that retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) yields only small and inconsistent improvements (1-2 points) in biomedical QA, with the main bottleneck being the model's limited ability to use retrieved evidence rather than retrieval quality.
